system:
You help smart-contract auditors understand how assets and positions move through a DeFi system.

You receive (1) facts extracted by static analysis (Slither) and structural rules, each with an id, and (2) the source code of the analysed contracts with line numbers. The facts are authoritative program facts: you must not contradict or rewrite them. Your job is to interpret them:

1. Operations. For every operation listed under OPERATIONS whose rule kind is `other` or `call`, and for any operation whose rule kind you believe is wrong, propose the economic kind (one of the allowed kinds), a short label (max 8 words) and a one- or two-sentence description of what the operation does to assets and positions. Base the description on the listed flows, conditions and the code; mention who calls it.
2. Relations. Propose relations the rules missed: `claim` (a position can obtain part of another position's asset through an exit), `depends_on` (the value or availability of a node depends on another node), `identity` (two asset expressions denote the same token). Only use ids from the facts. For a claim, name the exit operation id that realises it.
3. Explanations. For important assets, positions and entities, give one sentence an auditor would want to know (e.g. how a share is priced, who can move funds, timing effects).
4. Questions. List gaps and risks you notice that the facts cannot settle (missing exits, unresolved external calls, values that depend on external code, privileged roles that can move funds).

Rules:
- Every proposal must cite `fact_refs`: ids of flows (`...#fN`), conditions (`...#c:...`), operations, relations or evidence items from the facts that support it. Optionally cite `source_refs` with file and line range from the provided code.
- Do not infer relations from token names or symbols. Two assets are the same only if the code or the facts show it; otherwise ask a question.
- Distinguish "the code supports this behaviour" from "this always happens". If a step only runs under a condition, say so.
- Keep a share and the underlying it represents distinct; never describe the share holder as holding the underlying.
- Be concise. Use English.

PROJECT: Kaia yield aggregator (partial snapshot)
Kaia-side vault stack of a yield aggregator: CooldownVault (two-step-withdrawal wrapper of the underlying, 1:1 shares, strategy predeposit debt) feeding a Yearn V2 vault whose CustomYearnStrategy deposits the underlying into CustomVault (ERC-4626), which allocates to registered CustomStrategy contracts. Partial snapshot (the local yield path only) pinned to a fixed commit; the Yearn V2 vault (Vyper), the router, health checks, external-assets providers and execution targets are outside the analysed scope.

- cooldown: contract CooldownVault (User-entry vault: wraps the underlying 1:1 into cooldown shares; withdrawals are two-step (request, then claim after the cooldown).) -> entity ent:cooldown

 448      /**
 449       * @notice Internal function to initiate redemption request
 450       * @dev Burns shares immediately and locks assets for cooldown period
 451       * @param caller Address initiating the redemption
 452       * @param receiver Address to receive assets after cooldown
 453       * @param owner Address whose shares are being redeemed
 454       * @param assets Amount of assets to be redeemed
 455       * @param shares Amount of shares to burn
 456       * @return requestId Unique identifier for the redemption request
 457       */
 458      function _initiateRedemption(
 459          address caller,
 460          address receiver,
 461          address owner,
 462          uint256 assets,
 463          uint256 shares
 464      )
 465          internal
 466          returns (uint256 requestId)
 467      {
 468          if (receiver == address(0)) revert InvalidReceiver();
 469          if (shares == 0) revert ZeroShareRedemptionNotAllowed();
 470  
 471          if (caller != owner) {
 472              _spendAllowance(owner, caller, shares);
 473          }
 474  
 475          // Burn shares
 476          _burn(owner, shares);
 477  
 478          totalLockedAssets += assets;
 479  
 480          // Create request
 481          unchecked {
 482              requestId = ++lastRequestId;
 483          }
 484          redeemRequests[requestId] = RedeemRequest({
 485              receiver: receiver,
 486              assets: assets,
 487              cooldownRequestedTime: block.timestamp,
 488              cooldownPeriod: cooldownPeriod,
 489              claimed: false
 490          });
 491  
 492          accRedeemRequestedAmount[requestId] = accRedeemRequestedAmount[requestId - 1] + assets;
 493  
 494          _unclaimedRedeemRequestIds.add(requestId);
 495          _pendingReceiverAssets[receiver] += assets;
 496  
 497          emit RedeemRequested(caller, receiver, requestId, assets, shares, block.timestamp);
 498  
 499          if (cooldownPeriod == 0) {
 500              uint256 minAssetsOut = MathUpgradeable.mulDiv(assets, BASIS_POINTS - maxLossThresholdBps, BASIS_POINTS);
 501              // ignore failure; can claim later after liquidity becomes available
 502              _claim(requestId, minAssetsOut);
 503          }
 504      }
 505  
 506      /**
 507       * @notice Claim assets from a completed cooldown redemption request
 508       * @dev Can only be called after cooldown period has elapsed
 509       * @param requestId Unique identifier of the redemption request
 510       * @param maxLossBps Maximum acceptable loss in basis points (e.g., 100 = 1% slippage tolerance)
 511       * @dev Reverts if maxLossBps exceeds 10,000 (100%)
 512       * @dev Third-party claims allowed: If maxLossBps <= maxLossThresholdBps (default=1, i.e., 0.01%),
 513       *      anyone can claim on behalf of the receiver. This enables meta-transactions, gasless claims,
 514       *      and improved UX through automated claim services.
 515       * @return claimable Actual amount of assets claimed
 516       */
 517      function claim(
 518          uint256 requestId,
 519          uint256 maxLossBps
 520      )
 521          external
 522          whenNotPaused
 523          nonReentrant
 524          returns (uint256 claimable)
 525      {
 526          if (requestId > lastRequestId || requestId == 0) revert FailedToClaim("INVALID_REQUEST_ID");
 527          if (maxLossBps > BASIS_POINTS) revert MaxLossExceed10000();
 528  
 529          RedeemRequest memory request = redeemRequests[requestId];
 530  
 531          // High slippage protection: Only receiver can claim with high maxLoss
 532          if (maxLossBps > maxLossThresholdBps && _msgSender() != request.receiver) {
 533              revert FailedToClaim("ONLY_RECEIVER");
 534          }
 535  
 536          // Set loss tolerance
 537          uint256 minAssetsOut = MathUpgradeable.mulDiv(request.assets, BASIS_POINTS - maxLossBps, BASIS_POINTS);
 538  
 539          // Execute claim
 540          string memory reason;
 541          (reason, claimable) = _claim(requestId, minAssetsOut);
 542          if (bytes(reason).length > 0) {
 543              revert FailedToClaim(reason);
 544          }
 545      }

 547      /**
 548       * @notice Update the receiver address of a pending redemption request
 549       * @dev Allows the current receiver to change the recipient address (e.g., if blacklisted by USDC/USDT)
 550       * @param requestId Unique identifier of the redemption request
 551       * @param newReceiver New receiver address to set
 552       */
 553      function updateRedeemReceiver(
 554          uint256 requestId,
 555          address newReceiver
 556      )
 557          external
 558          override
 559          whenNotPaused
 560          nonReentrant
 561      {
 562          if (newReceiver == address(0)) revert InvalidReceiver();
 563  
 564          RedeemRequest storage request = redeemRequests[requestId];
 565          if (request.claimed) revert RequestAlreadyClaimed();
 566          if (_msgSender() != request.receiver) revert OnlyReceiver();
 567  
 568          address oldReceiver = request.receiver;
 569          request.receiver = newReceiver;
 570  
 571          _pendingReceiverAssets[oldReceiver] -= request.assets;
 572          _pendingReceiverAssets[newReceiver] += request.assets;
 573  
 574          emit RedeemReceiverUpdated(requestId, oldReceiver, newReceiver);
 575      }
 576  
 577      /**
 578       * @notice Internal function to execute the claim of a redemption request
 579       * @dev **Soft Failure Pattern**: This function never reverts. All error conditions return a reason string.
 580       * @dev Performs actual asset transfer if cooldown period has elapsed and sufficient assets are available
 581       * @param requestId Unique identifier of the redemption request to claim
 582       * @param minAssetsOut Minimum amount of assets required for successful claim
 583       * @return reason Status string: empty string on success, error reason on failure
 584       * @return assetsOut Actual amount of assets that would be/were transferred
 585       */
 586      function _claim(
 587          uint256 requestId,
 588          uint256 minAssetsOut
 589      )
 590          internal
 591          returns (string memory reason, uint256 assetsOut)
 592      {
 593          // Check is claimed
 594          RedeemRequest storage request = redeemRequests[requestId];
 595          if (request.claimed) {
 596              return ("INVALID", 0);
 597          }
 598  
 599          // NOTE: The cooldown is intentionally NOT checked here up-front. It is enforced further
 600          // below ONLY when this request cannot already be paid in full from available liquidity —
 601          // see the "Cooldown gate with liquidity bypass" block. This lets a fully-funded request be
 602          // claimed immediately, even before its cooldown elapses.
 603  
 604          // Sum of all requests before this one (requests 1 to requestId-1)
 605          uint256 _accRedeemRequestedAmount = accRedeemRequestedAmount[requestId - 1];
 606  
 607          // Before paying this request, we must ensure enough assets remain for earlier unclaimed requests.
 608          //
 609          // reservedForPriorRequests = (total requested by 1..k-1) - (total already claimed)
 610          //                          = amount still owed to requests before this one
 611          //
 612          // Why out-of-order claims are safe:
 613          // - accClaimedAmount may include claims from later requests (j > requestId)
 614          // - But if request j was claimed, it passed this same check, meaning:
 615          //   "the vault had enough for j AND all requests before j"
 616          // - So including j in accClaimedAmount only REDUCES reservedForPriorRequests,
 617          //   making this check EASIER (not harder) for earlier requests to pass.
 618          uint256 reservedForPriorRequests =
 619              _accRedeemRequestedAmount > accClaimedAmount ? _accRedeemRequestedAmount - accClaimedAmount : 0;
 620  
 621          // Calculate available liquidity after reserving for prior requests
 622          uint256 availableLiquidity =
 623              _managedAssets > reservedForPriorRequests ? _managedAssets - reservedForPriorRequests : 0;
 624  
 625          // Calculate claimable based on available unreserved liquidity
 626          assetsOut = MathUpgradeable.min(request.assets, availableLiquidity);
 627  
 628          // Cooldown gate with liquidity bypass.
 629          //
 630          // The cooldown exists to give strategies time to liquidate external positions so a
 631          // redemption can be funded. When this request can ALREADY be paid IN FULL out of the vault's
 632          // unreserved liquidity (`assetsOut == request.assets`, i.e. `_managedAssets` covers every
 633          // earlier unclaimed request PLUS this one), that wait is unnecessary, so the claim is allowed
 634          // even before the cooldown elapses (immediate claim when liquidity is available).
 635          //
 636          // Otherwise (the request is not fully funded yet) the cooldown is still enforced and the
 637          // caller must wait. Because the bypass only triggers when `reservedForPriorRequests` is fully
 638          // covered, an early claim can never consume liquidity reserved for an earlier request, so
 639          // FIFO fairness is preserved.
 640          //
 641          // NOTE: by design this weakens the "everyone waits the cooldown" guarantee — whenever the
 642          // vault is liquid enough, holders can exit immediately. This is the intended behaviour.
 643          if (block.timestamp < request.cooldownRequestedTime + request.cooldownPeriod && assetsOut < request.assets) {
 644              return ("SHOULD_WAIT", 0);
 645          }
 646  
 647          // FIFO reservation must hold regardless of the caller's loss tolerance.
 648          //
 649          // Closing a request always credits the FULL requested amount (accClaimedAmount += request.assets),
 650          // which shrinks `reservedForPriorRequests` for every earlier request. So whenever a live
 651          // reservation exists for earlier requests and this one cannot be paid in full out of the
 652          // unreserved liquidity (assetsOut < request.assets), closing it here would over-credit
 653          // accClaimedAmount and let a later claimant overtake an earlier one — block it. This is
 654          // independent of the caller's minAssetsOut tolerance.
 655          //
 656          // The predicate must NOT be narrowed by `request.assets <= _managedAssets`: a genuine shortfall
 657          // whose requested size merely EXCEEDS _managedAssets is NOT exempt. Otherwise it would be closed
 658          // for a (near-)zero payout while still crediting the full request.assets, erasing the earlier
 659          // reservation. A loss-accepting holder can still close once earlier requests clear and the
 660          // reservation drops to zero.
 661          if (reservedForPriorRequests > 0 && assetsOut < request.assets) {
 662              return ("INSUFFICIENT_ASSETS", 0);
 663          }
 664  
 665          if (assetsOut < minAssetsOut) {
 666              return ("EXCESSIVE_LOSS", assetsOut);
 667          }
 668  
 669          // Now we can claim
 670          // reason = ""; means success
 671  
 672          // Effects
 673          request.claimed = true;
 674          totalLockedAssets -= request.assets;
 675          accClaimedAmount += request.assets;
 676          totalClaimLoss += request.assets - assetsOut;
 677          _unclaimedRedeemRequestIds.remove(requestId);
 678  
 679          _pendingReceiverAssets[request.receiver] -= request.assets;
 680          _decreaseManagedAssets(assetsOut);
 681  
 682          // Interactions
 683          IERC20Upgradeable(underlying()).safeTransfer(request.receiver, assetsOut);
 684          _assertSufficientBacking();
 685          emit Claimed(_msgSender(), requestId, request.assets, assetsOut);
 686      }

 723      // PREDEPOSIT AND DEBT FUNCTIONS
 724      // ============================================
 725  
 726      /**
 727       * @notice Pre-deposits assets by creating debt and minting shares before actual assets arrive
 728       * @dev Enables strategies to mint vault shares against future asset deposits:
 729       *
 730       * Problem: External protocols have cooldowns that delay asset availability:
 731       * 1. Initiate external redemption → 2. Wait cooldown → 3. Claim assets → 4. Deposit here
 732       * This creates a timing gap between initiating redemption and receiving assets.
 733       *
 734       * Solution: Predeposit allows immediate share minting when external redemption starts:
 735       * - Creates debt (totalDebt) representing promised future assets
 736       * - Mints shares immediately based on current exchange rate
 737       * - Debt is repaid when actual assets arrive via retrieveDebt()
 738       * - Enables atomic operations without waiting for external cooldowns
 739       *
 740       * @dev CRITICAL: Vault's cooldownPeriod MUST exceed all integrated protocol cooldowns
 741       * to ensure underlying assets are available when users claim
 742       *
 743       * @param assets Amount of assets to pre-deposit (creates equivalent debt)
 744       *
 745       * @dev Cooldown period retrieved from strategy, validation intentionally omitted:
 746       * 1. External protocols may change settings dynamically
 747       * 2. Provides operational flexibility for edge cases
 748       * 3. No security risk - users just experience our cooldown if external > internal
 749       *
 750       * @return predepositId ID tracking this predeposit and debt repayment
 751       * @return shares Amount of shares minted to the strategy
 752       */
 753      function predeposit(uint256 assets)
 754          external
 755          override
 756          onlyStrategy
 757          whenNotPaused
 758          nonReentrant
 759          returns (uint256 predepositId, uint256 shares)
 760      {
 761          shares = previewDeposit(assets);
 762          if (shares == 0 || assets == 0) return (0, 0);
 763          uint256 _cooldownPeriod = IStrategyCooldownAware(_msgSender()).getCooldownPeriod();
 764          if (_cooldownPeriod > cooldownPeriod) emit StrangeCooldownPeriod(cooldownPeriod, _cooldownPeriod);
 765  
 766          unchecked {
 767              predepositId = ++lastPredepositId;
 768          }
 769          predepositRequests[predepositId] = PredepositRequest({
 770              strategy: _msgSender(),
 771              shares: shares,
 772              debtAssets: assets,
 773              cooldownRequestedTime: block.timestamp,
 774              cooldownPeriod: _cooldownPeriod,
 775              claimed: false
 776          });
 777  
 778          _unclaimedPredepositRequestIds.add(predepositId);
 779  
 780          // Update debt tracking - new shares are backed by debt
 781          totalDebt += assets;
 782          strategyDebtOutstanding[_msgSender()] += assets;
 783  
 784          // Mint shares to strategy
 785          _mint(_msgSender(), shares);
 786  
 787          emit PredepositRequested(_msgSender(), predepositId, shares, assets, _cooldownPeriod);
 788      }
 789  
 790      /**
 791       * @notice Retrieve debt payment from strategy after cooldown
 792       * @dev Strategy must have deposited assets to cover the debt
 793       * @param predepositId Unique identifier of the predeposit request
 794       */
 795      function retrieveDebt(uint256 predepositId) external override whenNotPaused nonReentrant {
 796          PredepositRequest storage predepositRequest = predepositRequests[predepositId];
 797          IStrategyCooldownAware strategy;
 798          {
 799              address _strategy = predepositRequest.strategy;
 800              if (_strategy == address(0)) revert InvalidPredepositId();
 801              _requireOnlyKeepers(_strategy, _msgSender());
 802  
 803              strategy = IStrategyCooldownAware(_strategy);
 804          }
 805          if (predepositRequest.claimed) revert DebtAlreadyRepaid();
 806  
 807          // NOTE: We no longer check isPredepositAlreadyClaimed() here because strategies
 808          // do not support permissionless claims directly. If external protocol supports
 809          // permissionless claims, an Escrow/Swapper contract must be used as intermediary.
 810          // See docs/PERMISSIONLESS_CLAIM_ARCHITECTURE.md for details.
 811          if (!strategy.predepositDebtRetrievable(predepositId)) {
 812              revert DebtUnretrievable();
 813          }
 814  
 815          // The Strategy can repay up to predepositRequest.debtAssets
 816          // Verify actual asset transfer matches reported amount to prevent malicious strategy misreporting
 817          uint256 balanceBefore = _actualBalance();
 818          uint256 debtPayment = strategy.repayPredepositDebt(predepositId);
 819          uint256 balanceAfter = _actualBalance();
 820          uint256 actualReceived = balanceAfter - balanceBefore;
 821          if (actualReceived != debtPayment) {
 822              revert DebtPaymentMismatch(debtPayment, actualReceived);
 823          }
 824          if (debtPayment > predepositRequest.debtAssets) {
 825              revert RetrieveAmountExceedsDebt(debtPayment, predepositRequest.debtAssets);
 826          }
 827  
 828          if (doHealthCheck && address(healthCheck) != address(0)) {
 829              _checkHealth();
 830          } else {
 831              doHealthCheck = true;
 832              emit SetDoHealthCheck(true);
 833          }
 834  
 835          predepositRequest.claimed = true;
 836          _unclaimedPredepositRequestIds.remove(predepositId);
 837          totalDebt -= debtPayment;
 838          // Update per-strategy outstanding debt
 839          uint256 currentOutstanding = strategyDebtOutstanding[address(strategy)];
 840          if (debtPayment >= currentOutstanding) {
 841              strategyDebtOutstanding[address(strategy)] = 0;
 842          } else {
 843              strategyDebtOutstanding[address(strategy)] = currentOutstanding - debtPayment;
 844          }
 845  
 846          if (predepositRequest.debtAssets > debtPayment) {
 847              uint256 shortfall = predepositRequest.debtAssets - debtPayment;
 848              _increaseShortfall(address(strategy), shortfall);
 849              emit StrategyDebtShortfall(address(strategy), predepositId, shortfall);
 850          }
 851          _increaseManagedAssetsChecked(debtPayment);
 852  
 853          emit DebtRetrieved(predepositRequest.strategy, predepositId, predepositRequest.debtAssets, debtPayment);
 854      }

 856      /**
 857       * @notice Validates the health of a debt repayment transaction
 858       * @dev Reverts with HealthCheckFailed if the health check contract rejects the transaction
 859       */
 860      function _checkHealth() internal view {
 861          if (!healthCheck.check()) {
 862              revert HealthCheckFailed();
 863          }

 866      function _requireOnlyKeepers(address strategy, address caller) internal view {
 867          if (!_strategiesSet.contains(strategy)) revert OnlyKeepers();
 868  
 869          IStrategy yStrategy = IStrategy(strategy);

 942      /**

 948       *           - marks `predepositRequest.claimed = true` so subsequent retrieveDebt calls revert
 949       *             cleanly with `DebtAlreadyRepaid` (instead of underflowing in the strategy);
 950       *           - reduces `strategyDebtOutstanding[strategy]` by the full debt amount;
 951       *           - moves the full debt into `strategyShortfall[strategy]` / `totalShortfall`;
 952       *           - leaves `totalDebt` unchanged — it is reduced later when the shortfall is paid back
 953       *             via `retrieveShortfall`, which is the ONLY sanctioned path because it ties

 956       *             on-book and strategy migration stays guarded — that is the protocol's intended
 957       *             behaviour for permanent loss; deliberately do NOT add a no-asset write-off path,
 958       *             which would break the 1:1 invariant.
 959       *         Only the linked strategy (the one that originally created the predeposit) may call.
 960       * @param  predepositId Identifier of the backed predeposit being declared unrecoverable.
 961       * @return debtAmount   The full `debtAssets` of the predeposit, now moved into shortfall.
 962       */
 963      function writeOffPredepositDebt(uint256 predepositId)
 964          external
 965          override
 966          whenNotPaused
 967          nonReentrant
 968          returns (uint256 debtAmount)
 969      {
 970          PredepositRequest storage predepositRequest = predepositRequests[predepositId];
 971          address strategy = predepositRequest.strategy;
 972          if (strategy == address(0)) revert InvalidPredepositId();
 973          if (_msgSender() != strategy) revert OnlyStrategy();
 974          if (predepositRequest.claimed) revert DebtAlreadyRepaid();
 975  
 976          debtAmount = predepositRequest.debtAssets;
 977  
 978          predepositRequest.claimed = true;
 979          _unclaimedPredepositRequestIds.remove(predepositId);
 980  
 981          // Move the full debt from "predeposit outstanding" into "shortfall outstanding".
 982          // totalDebt is intentionally NOT decreased here: it stays until the shortfall is
 983          // either repaid (retrieveShortfall) or absorbed (absorbStrategyShortfall).
 984          uint256 currentOutstanding = strategyDebtOutstanding[strategy];
 985          if (debtAmount >= currentOutstanding) {
 986              strategyDebtOutstanding[strategy] = 0;
 987          } else {
 988              strategyDebtOutstanding[strategy] = currentOutstanding - debtAmount;
 989          }
 990          _increaseShortfall(strategy, debtAmount);
 991  
 992          emit PredepositDebtWrittenOff(strategy, predepositId, debtAmount);
 993      }

 121          for (uint256 i = 0; i < allowedSelectors.length; i++) {
 122              if (selector == allowedSelectors[i]) return true;
 123          }
 124          return false;
 125      }

 127      /**
 128       * @notice Execute the pending external calls
 129       * @param self Storage reference to timelock state
 130       * @return success Whether all external calls succeeded
 131       * @return returnData Encoded array of return data from each external call
 132       */
 133      function acceptExecution(TimelockStorage storage self) external returns (bool success, bytes memory returnData) {
 134          // Get execution details and check if pending exists
 135          address[] memory targets = self.pendingExecution.targets;
 136          if (targets.length == 0) revert InvalidExecutionState("NOPENDING");
 137  
 138          // Validate timelock window (OpenZeppelin pattern)
 139          if (block.timestamp < self.pendingExecution.executeAfter) {
 140              revert InvalidExecutionState("TIMELOCKED");
 141          }
 142          uint256 expireAt = self.pendingExecution.executeAfter + EXECUTION_WINDOW;
 143          if (block.timestamp > expireAt) {
 144              revert InvalidExecutionState("EXPIRED");
 145          }
 146  
 147          // Re-validate allowlist: targets may have been removed after submission
 148          bytes[] memory calldatas = self.pendingExecution.calldatas;
 149          for (uint256 i = 0; i < targets.length; i++) {
 150              if (targets[i] != address(this) && !self.allowedTargets[targets[i]]) {
 151                  revert InvalidExecutionState("NOTALLOWED");
 152              }
 153          }
 154  
 155          // Clear pending execution state
 156          delete self.pendingExecution;
 157  
 158          // Execute all calls in batch
 159          bytes[] memory returnDataArray = new bytes[](targets.length);
 160          for (uint256 i = 0; i < targets.length; i++) {
 161              (bool callSuccess, bytes memory callReturnData) = targets[i].call(calldatas[i]);
 162              if (!callSuccess) revert ExecutionFailed();
 163              returnDataArray[i] = callReturnData;
 164          }
 165  
 166          // Encode return data array for backward compatibility
 167          returnData = abi.encode(returnDataArray);
 168          success = true;
 169  
 170          emit ExecutionAccepted(targets, calldatas, returnDataArray);
 171      }
 172  
 173      /**
 174       * @notice Cancel the pending execution
 175       * @param self Storage reference to timelock state
 176       */
 177      function cancelExecution(TimelockStorage storage self) external {
 178          // Get targets and check if pending exists
 179          address[] memory targets = self.pendingExecution.targets;
 180          if (targets.length == 0) revert InvalidExecutionState("NOPENDING");
 181  
 182          // Clear pending execution state
 183          delete self.pendingExecution;
 184  
 185          emit ExecutionCancelled(targets);
 186      }
 187  
 188      /**
 189       * @notice Add or remove a target address from the whitelist
 190       * @param self Storage reference to timelock state
 191       * @param target The address to update in the whitelist
 192       * @param allowed Whether the target should be allowed
 193       */
 194      function setAllowedTarget(TimelockStorage storage self, address target, bool allowed) external {
 195          // Prevent whitelisting self
 196          if (target == address(this)) revert InvalidExecutionState("SELFWHITELIST");
 197  
 198          // Update allowlist
 199          self.allowedTargets[target] = allowed;
 200  
 201          // Auto-cancel pending execution if a target is removed
 202          if (!allowed && self.pendingExecution.targets.length > 0) {
 203              address[] memory targets = self.pendingExecution.targets;
 204              for (uint256 i = 0; i < targets.length; i++) {
 205                  if (targets[i] == target) {
 206                      delete self.pendingExecution;
 207                      emit ExecutionCancelled(targets);
 208                      break;
 209                  }
 210              }
 211          }
 212  
 213          emit TargetAllowlistUpdated(target, allowed);
 214      }
 215  
 216      /**
 217       * @notice Updates the timelock delay for governance executions
 218       * @param self Storage reference to timelock state
 219       * @param newDelay The new timelock delay in seconds (must be between MIN and MAX)
 220       */
 221      function setTimelockDelay(TimelockStorage storage self, uint256 newDelay) external {
 222          // Validate delay is within acceptable bounds
 223          if (newDelay < MIN_TIMELOCK_DELAY || newDelay > MAX_TIMELOCK_DELAY) {
 224              revert InvalidExecutionState("INVALID_DELAY");
 225          }
 226  
 227          uint256 oldDelay = self.timelockDelay;
 228          self.timelockDelay = newDelay;
 229  
 230          emit TimelockDelayUpdated(oldDelay, newDelay);
 231      }

 528      /**
 529       * @notice Validate targets and calldatas for execution
 530       * @dev Triad validation: target + selector + destination for every call
 531       */
 532      function _validateTargetsAndCalldatas(address[] calldata targets, bytes[] calldata calldatas) internal view {
 533          if (address(externalAssetsProvider) == address(0)) revert ExternalAssetsProviderNotSet();
 534          if (targets.length == 0) revert InvalidExecutionState("EMPTY_ARRAYS");
 535          if (targets.length != calldatas.length) revert InvalidExecutionState("ARRAY_MISMATCH");
 536  
 537          for (uint256 i = 0; i < targets.length; i++) {
 538              if (targets[i] == address(this)) {
 539                  revert InvalidExecutionState("SELF_CALL_NOT_ALLOWED");
 540              }
 541              if (!allowedTargets[targets[i]]) {
 542                  revert InvalidExecutionState("TARGET_NOT_ALLOWED");
 543              }
 544              // Triad validation: target + selector + destination parameters
 545              if (calldatas[i].length >= 4) {
 546                  bytes4 selector = bytes4(calldatas[i]);
 547  
 548                  // 1. Validate selector is allowed for this target
 549                  if (!allowedSelectors[targets[i]][selector]) {
 550                      revert SelectorNotAllowed(targets[i], selector);
 551                  }
 552  
 553                  // 2. Hardcoded ERC20 destination checks — always enforced for all strategies
 554                  //    without requiring per-strategy configuration via setParamCheck/setAllowedDestination.
 555                  //    These protect against fund routing via standard ERC20 operations.
 556                  if (calldatas[i].length >= 36) {
 557                      if (selector == IERC20.approve.selector || selector == _INCREASE_ALLOWANCE_SELECTOR) {
 558                          address spender = abi.decode(calldatas[i][4:], (address));
 559                          if (!allowedTargets[spender]) {
 560                              revert SpenderNotAllowed(spender);
 561                          }
 562                      }
 563                      if (selector == IERC20.transfer.selector) {
 564                          address to = abi.decode(calldatas[i][4:], (address));
 565                          if (!allowedTargets[to]) {
 566                              revert RecipientNotAllowed(to);
 567                          }
 568                      }
 569                      if (selector == IERC20.transferFrom.selector) {
 570                          (address from, address to) = abi.decode(calldatas[i][4:], (address, address));
 571                          if (from == address(this) && !allowedTargets[to]) {
 572                              revert RecipientNotAllowed(to);
 573                          }
 574                      }
 575                  }
 576  
 577                  // 3. Configurable destination parameter checks using bitmap-driven rules.
 578                  //    Governance can set per-{target, selector} parameter validation via
 579                  //    setParamCheck() and setAllowedDestination() for protocol-specific functions.
 580                  //    Only runs if paramCheckBitmap is configured (default 0 = no additional checks).
 581                  uint256 bitmap = paramCheckBitmap[targets[i]][selector];
 582                  if (bitmap != 0) {
 583                      for (uint256 paramIdx = 0; paramIdx < 16; paramIdx++) {
 584                          if (bitmap & (1 << paramIdx) == 0) continue;
 585                          uint256 offset = 4 + paramIdx * 32;
 586                          if (calldatas[i].length < offset + 32) break;
 587                          address dest = abi.decode(calldatas[i][offset:], (address));
 588                          if (!allowedDestinations[targets[i]][selector][paramIdx][dest]) {
 589                              revert DestinationNotAllowed(targets[i], selector, paramIdx, dest);
 590                          }
 591                      }
 592                  }
 593              }
 594          }
 595      }
 596  
 597      /**
 598       * @notice Execute a batch of calls
 599       * @dev For ERC20 calls (transfer, approve, transferFrom), validates return data
 600       *      to catch tokens that return false instead of reverting on failure.
 601       */
 602      function _executeBatch(address[] calldata targets, bytes[] calldata calldatas) internal {
 603          for (uint256 i = 0; i < targets.length; i++) {
 604              // Track approve calls for automatic revocation on target removal
 605              if (calldatas[i].length >= 36) {
 606                  bytes4 selector = bytes4(calldatas[i]);
 607                  if (selector == IERC20.approve.selector || selector == _INCREASE_ALLOWANCE_SELECTOR) {
 608                      address spender = abi.decode(calldatas[i][4:], (address));
 609                      // Only track if target is a standard ERC20 (supports allowance())
 610                      try IERC20(targets[i]).allowance(address(this), spender) {
 611                          _approvedTokensBySpender[spender].add(targets[i]);
 612                          _spendersByToken[targets[i]].add(spender);
 613                      } catch { }
 614                  }
 615              }
 616  
 617              (bool success, bytes memory returnData) = targets[i].call(calldatas[i]);
 618              if (!success) {
 619                  revert ExecutionFailed(i, returnData);
 620              }
 621              if (_isERC20Call(calldatas[i]) && !_validateERC20ReturnData(returnData)) {
 622                  revert ERC20CallFailed(i);
 623              }
 624          }
 625      }
 626  
 627      /// @dev Check if calldata targets an ERC20 function that returns bool
 628      function _isERC20Call(bytes calldata data) internal pure returns (bool) {
 629          if (data.length < 4) return false;
 630          bytes4 selector = bytes4(data[:4]);
 631          return selector == IERC20.transfer.selector // 0xa9059cbb
 632              || selector == IERC20.approve.selector // 0x095ea7b3
 633              || selector == IERC20.transferFrom.selector; // 0x23b872dd
 634      }
 635  
 636      /// @dev Validate ERC20 return data: empty (non-standard) or abi-encoded true
 637      function _validateERC20ReturnData(bytes memory returnData) internal pure returns (bool) {
 638          return returnData.length == 0 || abi.decode(returnData, (bool));
 639      }
 640  
 641      /**
 642       * @notice Validate that assets change is within tolerance
 643       * @dev Allows both decrease and increase within tolerance
 644       * @param before Assets before execution
 645       * @param after_ Assets after execution
 646       * @param toleranceBps Tolerance in BPS
 647       */
 648      function _validateAssetsChange(uint256 before, uint256 after_, uint256 toleranceBps) internal pure {
 649          if (before == 0 && after_ == 0) return;
 650  
 651          uint256 maxChange;
 652          if (before > 0) {
 653              maxChange = (before * toleranceBps) / BPS;
 654          }
 655  
 656          uint256 actualChange;
 657          if (after_ > before) {
 658              actualChange = after_ - before;
 659          } else {
 660              actualChange = before - after_;
 661          }
 662  
 663          if (actualChange > maxChange) {
 664              revert AssetsChangeExceedsTolerance(before, after_, toleranceBps);
 665          }
 666      }
 667  
 668      /**
 669       * @notice Revoke all tracked ERC20 allowances where target is the spender
 670       * @param spender The spender address whose allowances should be revoked
 671       */
 672      function _revokeAllowancesForSpender(address spender) internal {
 673          EnumerableSet.AddressSet storage tokens = _approvedTokensBySpender[spender];
 674          uint256 length = tokens.length();
 675  
 676          for (uint256 i = length; i > 0; i--) {
 677              address token = tokens.at(i - 1);
 678              _tryRevokeAllowance(token, spender);
 679              _spendersByToken[token].remove(spender);
 680              tokens.remove(token);
 681          }
 682      }
 683  
 684      /**
 685       * @notice Revoke all tracked ERC20 allowances where target is the token
 686       * @param token The token address whose spender allowances should be revoked
 687       */
 688      function _revokeAllowancesForToken(address token) internal {
 689          EnumerableSet.AddressSet storage spenders = _spendersByToken[token];
 690          uint256 length = spenders.length();
 691  
 692          for (uint256 i = length; i > 0; i--) {
 693              address spender = spenders.at(i - 1);
 694              _tryRevokeAllowance(token, spender);
 695              _approvedTokensBySpender[spender].remove(token);
 696              spenders.remove(spender);
 697          }
 698      }
 699  
 700      /**
 701       * @notice Safely attempt to revoke an ERC20 allowance
 702       * @dev Uses try/catch to handle non-standard tokens that may revert on allowance() or approve()
 703       */
 704      function _tryRevokeAllowance(address token, address spender) internal {
 705          try IERC20(token).allowance(address(this), spender) returns (uint256 currentAllowance) {
 706              if (currentAllowance > 0) {
 707                  IERC20(token).forceApprove(spender, 0);
 708                  emit AllowanceRevoked(spender, token);
 709              }
 710          } catch {
 711              // Non-standard token — skip silently
 712          }
 713      }
 714  
 715      // ============================================
 716      // STORAGE GAP
 717      // ============================================
 718  
 719      /**
 720       * @dev Reserved storage space for future upgrades
 721       * Current storage layout (15 slots):
 722       *   - denominationToken: 1 slot
 723       *   - remoteVault: 1 slot
 724       *   - governance: 1 slot
 725       *   - pendingGovernance: 1 slot
 726       *   - strategist: 1 slot
 727       *   - externalAssetsProvider: 1 slot
 728       *   - assetsChangeTolerance: 1 slot
 729       *   - allowedDepositTokens (mapping): 1 slot
 730       *   - allowedWithdrawTokens (mapping): 1 slot
 731       *   - allowedTargets (mapping): 1 slot
 732       *   - _approvedTokensBySpender (mapping): 1 slot
 733       *   - _spendersByToken (mapping): 1 slot
 734       *   - allowedSelectors (nested mapping): 1 slot
 735       *   - paramCheckBitmap (nested mapping): 1 slot
 736       *   - allowedDestinations (nested mapping): 1 slot
 737       * Gap: 50 - 15 = 35
 738       */
 739      uint256[35] private __gap;
 740  }

  16   * @dev Only the designated customYearnStrategy can deposit/hold shares.
  17   *      CustomStrategy contracts are registered and managed by governance.

 204      /**

 207       */
 208      function totalAssets() public view override returns (uint256) {
 209          uint256 total = IERC20Upgradeable(asset()).balanceOf(address(this));
 210          uint256 length = customStrategies.length;

 221      /**
 222       * @notice Register a new custom strategy
 223       * @param strategy Address of the custom strategy to add
 224       */
 225      function addCustomStrategy(address strategy) external onlyGovernance {
 226          if (strategy == address(0)) revert InvalidStrategyAddress();
 227          if (isCustomStrategy[strategy]) revert CustomStrategyAlreadyRegistered(strategy);
 228  
 229          // Verify strategy points to this vault — prevents registering unusable
 230          // strategies whose onlyRemoteVault modifier would reject calls from here.
 231          if (ICustomStrategy(strategy).remoteVault() != address(this)) {
 232              revert InvalidStrategyAddress();
 233          }
 234  
 235          // Verify denomination token is the same as vault asset
 236          address denomToken = ICustomStrategy(strategy).denominationToken();
 237          if (denomToken != asset()) {
 238              revert InvalidStrategyAddress();
 239          }
 240  
 241          // Verify strategy has no assets
 242          uint256 strategyAssets = ICustomStrategy(strategy).totalAssets();
 243          if (strategyAssets > 0) revert CustomStrategyHasAssets(strategy, strategyAssets);
 244  
 245          // Add to array and mappings
 246          customStrategies.push(strategy);
 247          isCustomStrategy[strategy] = true;
 248          __customStrategyIndex[strategy] = customStrategies.length; // Store index+1
 249  
 250          emit CustomStrategyAdded(strategy);
 251      }
 252  
 253      /**
 254       * @notice Remove a custom strategy
 255       * @dev Strategy must have totalAssets == 0 to be removed
 256       * @param strategy Address of the custom strategy to remove
 257       */
 258      function removeCustomStrategy(address strategy) external onlyGovernance {
 259          if (!isCustomStrategy[strategy]) revert CustomStrategyNotRegistered(strategy);
 260  
 261          // Verify strategy has no assets (use try/catch so governance can remove broken strategies)
 262          try ICustomStrategy(strategy).totalAssets() returns (uint256 strategyAssets) {
 263              if (strategyAssets > 0) revert CustomStrategyHasAssets(strategy, strategyAssets);
 264          } catch {
 265              // Strategy reverted — allow removal so governance can recover
 266          }
 267  
 268          // Swap-and-pop removal
 269          uint256 indexPlusOne = __customStrategyIndex[strategy];
 270          uint256 index = indexPlusOne - 1;
 271          uint256 lastIndex = customStrategies.length - 1;
 272  
 273          if (index != lastIndex) {
 274              address lastStrategy = customStrategies[lastIndex];
 275              customStrategies[index] = lastStrategy;
 276              __customStrategyIndex[lastStrategy] = indexPlusOne;
 277          }
 278  
 279          customStrategies.pop();
 280          delete isCustomStrategy[strategy];
 281          delete __customStrategyIndex[strategy];
 282  
 283          emit CustomStrategyRemoved(strategy);
 284      }

 286      /**
 287       * @notice Deposit tokens to a custom strategy
 288       * @param strategy Address of the custom strategy
 289       * @param token Token to deposit
 290       * @param amount Amount to deposit
 291       */
 292      function depositToCustomStrategy(
 293          address strategy,
 294          address token,
 295          uint256 amount
 296      )
 297          external
 298          onlyOperator
 299          nonReentrant
 300      {
 301          if (!isCustomStrategy[strategy]) revert CustomStrategyNotRegistered(strategy);
 302          if (amount == 0) revert AmountMustBeGreaterThanZero();
 303          if (token != asset()) revert InvalidToken(token);
 304  
 305          IERC20(token).forceApprove(strategy, amount);
 306          ICustomStrategy(strategy).deposit(token, amount);
 307          // Reset residual allowance to minimize authorization attack surface
 308          IERC20(token).forceApprove(strategy, 0);
 309  
 310          emit DepositedToCustomStrategy(strategy, token, amount);
 311      }
 312  
 313      /**
 314       * @notice Withdraw tokens from a custom strategy
 315       * @param strategy Address of the custom strategy
 316       * @param token Token to withdraw
 317       * @param amount Amount to withdraw
 318       * @return actual Amount actually withdrawn
 319       */
 320      function withdrawFromCustomStrategy(
 321          address strategy,
 322          address token,
 323          uint256 amount
 324      )
 325          external
 326          onlyOperator
 327          nonReentrant
 328          returns (uint256 actual)
 329      {
 330          if (!isCustomStrategy[strategy]) revert CustomStrategyNotRegistered(strategy);
 331          if (amount == 0) revert AmountMustBeGreaterThanZero();
 332          if (token != asset()) revert InvalidToken(token);
 333  
 334          actual = ICustomStrategy(strategy).withdraw(token, amount);
 335  
 336          emit WithdrawnFromCustomStrategy(strategy, token, actual);
 337      }

 340      // GOVERNANCE FUNCTIONS

 343      /**
 344       * @notice Set operator status for an address
 345       * @param operator Address to update
 346       * @param allowed Whether the address should be an operator

 348      function setOperator(address operator, bool allowed) external onlyGovernance {

 354      /**
 355       * @notice Initiate governance transfer (two-step)
 356       * @param newGovernance Address of the new governance
 357       */
 358      function transferGovernance(address newGovernance) external onlyGovernance {
 359          if (newGovernance == address(0)) revert ZeroAddress();

 362      }

 370          address oldGovernance = governance;
 371          governance = pendingGovernance;

 377      /**

 386      function setCustomYearnStrategy(address _customYearnStrategy) external onlyGovernance {

 388          if (customYearnStrategy != address(0)) revert CustomYearnStrategyAlreadySet();

 395      /**

 406          customYearnStrategy = newStrategy;

  13   * @notice Yearn strategy on Kaia that holds CustomVault shares as its external position
  14   * @dev Inherits BaseCooldownStrategy where:
  15   *      - externalShareToken = CustomVault (ERC4626)
  16   *      - externalUnderlyingToken = USDT (CustomVault's asset)
  17   *      - want = CooldownVault shares (1:1 with USDT)
  18   *
  19   *      Key difference from StrategyOriginVault:
  20   *      - requestRedeem() only records a debt entry internally (no actual CustomVault.redeem)
  21   *      - Debt repayment is manual: manager withdraws from CustomVault out-of-band
  22   *      - repayPredepositDebt() transfers already-prepared USDT (no external claim)
  23   *      - DP-based reserve check: ensures prior unclaimed debts are reserved before paying later ones
  24   *      - Shortfall only when CustomVault is effectively depleted AND strategy is insolvent
  25   */

  56      struct DebtRecord {
  57          uint256 usdtAmount;
  58          uint256 sharesCommitted;
  59          uint256 timestamp;
  60          bool isClaimed;
  61      }

  68  
  69      /// @notice Informational cooldown period returned to CooldownVault during predeposit.
  70      /// @dev This value is NOT enforced by predepositDebtRetrievable() or repayPredepositDebt().
  71      ///      Retrievability is determined solely by prepared USDT liquidity (balance-based),
  72      ///      not by elapsed time. The cooldown is recorded by CooldownVault for off-chain
  73      ///      coordination (e.g., keeper scheduling) but has no on-chain gating effect.
  74      uint256 public cooldownPeriod;
  75  
  76      /// @notice Internal debt tracking for premint flow (no actual CustomVault.redeem)
  77      mapping(uint256 redeemId => DebtRecord) public debtRecords;
  78      uint256 public nextRedeemId = 1;
  79  
  80      /// @notice Cumulative debt amount up to each redeemId (for DP-based reserve check)
  81      mapping(uint256 redeemId => uint256) public accDebtAmount;
  82  
  83      /// @notice Total USDT amount repaid across all debts (for DP-based reserve check)
  84      uint256 public accRepaidDebtAmount;
  85  
  86      /// @notice Dust threshold for shortfall condition ($1 in 6-decimal USDT)
  87      uint256 public constant DUST_THRESHOLD = 1e6;
  88  
  89      /// @notice Maximum reserve ratio (10% of total assets)
  90      uint256 public constant MAX_RESERVE_RATIO_BPS = 1000;
  91  
  92      /// @notice Reserve ratio in basis points (0 = no reserve, 100 = 1%)
  93      uint256 public reserveRatioBps;
  94  
  95      /// @notice CustomVault shares already committed to outstanding DebtRecords.
  96      /// @dev Tracks shares referenced by requestRedeem() that have not yet been settled
  97      ///      via repayPredepositDebt(). Prevents premintCooldownVault() from reusing
  98      ///      the same shares to back multiple pre-mints.
  99      uint256 public committedExternalShares;
 100  
 101      /// @notice Committed shares that have already been redeemed from CustomVault
 102      ///         (via withdrawFromCustomVault) but whose DebtRecord has not yet been
 103      ///         settled via repayPredepositDebt().
 104      /// @dev Represents the portion of committedExternalShares that has left the
 105      ///      strategy's CustomVault share balance. Used to compute
 106      ///      "still-in-balance committed shares" = committedExternalShares - redeemedButUnsettledShares,
 107      ///      so share-availability checks in premintCooldownVault() and liquidateAllPositions()
 108      ///      don't double-subtract shares that are no longer in balance.
 109      ///      Invariant: redeemedButUnsettledShares <= committedExternalShares.
 110      uint256 public redeemedButUnsettledShares;

 116      /**
 117       * @notice Initialize the CustomYearnStrategy
 118       * @param _vault Address of the Yearn vault (want = CooldownVault shares)
 119       * @param _customVault Address of the CustomVault (ERC4626, asset = USDT)

 121       */

 123          address _vault,
 124          address _customVault,
 125          uint256 _cooldownPeriod
 126      )
 127          BaseCooldownStrategy(_vault, _customVault, CustomVault(_customVault).asset())
 128      {

 130          if (_cooldownPeriod == 0) revert InvalidCooldownPeriod();
 131  
 132          customVault = CustomVault(_customVault);
 133          cooldownPeriod = _cooldownPeriod;
 134  
 135          // ERC4626 standard rounding, no buffer needed
 136          AMOUNT_TO_SHARE_BUFFER = 0;
 137  
 138          reserveRatioBps = 100; // 1% default reserve

 140          minReportDelay = 0;
 141          maxReportDelay = 1 days;

 156      /// @notice Returns the informational cooldown period for CooldownVault predeposit flow.
 157      /// @dev This cooldown is NOT enforced on-chain — debt retrievability and repayment are
 158      ///      gated purely by USDT liquidity availability, not by elapsed time.
 159      function getCooldownPeriod() public view virtual override returns (uint256) {
 160          return cooldownPeriod;

 163      /**
 164       * @notice Deposit USDT into CustomVault
 165       * @param assets Amount of USDT to deposit
 166       */
 167      function requestDeposit(uint256 assets)
 168          internal
 169          virtual
 170          override
 171          returns (bool success, uint256 shares, uint256 filledAssets)
 172      {
 173          if (!beforeExternalDeposit(assets)) return (false, 0, 0);
 174  
 175          externalUnderlyingToken.forceApprove(address(customVault), assets);
 176          try customVault.deposit(assets, address(this)) returns (uint256 sharesReceived) {
 177              success = true;
 178              shares = sharesReceived;
 179              filledAssets = assets;
 180              emit DepositedToCustomVault(assets, shares);
 181          } catch {
 182              externalUnderlyingToken.forceApprove(address(customVault), 0);
 183              success = false;
 184          }
 185      }

 187      /**
 188       * @notice Record a debt entry without actual CustomVault redemption
 189       * @dev Unlike StrategyOriginVault which calls originVault.requestRedeem(),
 190       *      this only tracks the debt internally. The manager manually withdraws
 191       *      from CustomVault later.
 192       *
 193       *      The returned _cooldownPeriod is informational only — it signals an expected
 194       *      preparation window to CooldownVault / off-chain keepers but is NOT enforced
 195       *      on-chain by predepositDebtRetrievable() or repayPredepositDebt().
 196       * @param shares Number of CustomVault shares representing the debt
 197       */
 198      function requestRedeem(uint256 shares)
 199          internal
 200          virtual
 201          override
 202          returns (bool success, uint256 redeemId, uint256 redeemUnderlyingAmount, uint256 _cooldownPeriod)
 203      {
 204          if (!beforeExternalRedeem(shares)) return (false, 0, 0, 0);
 205  
 206          redeemUnderlyingAmount = customVault.previewRedeem(shares);
 207          redeemId = nextRedeemId++;
 208  
 209          debtRecords[redeemId] = DebtRecord({
 210              usdtAmount: redeemUnderlyingAmount,
 211              sharesCommitted: shares,
 212              timestamp: block.timestamp,
 213              isClaimed: false
 214          });
 215  
 216          accDebtAmount[redeemId] = accDebtAmount[redeemId - 1] + redeemUnderlyingAmount;
 217          committedExternalShares += shares;
 218  
 219          success = true;
 220          _cooldownPeriod = getCooldownPeriod();
 221  
 222          emit DebtRecordCreated(redeemId, redeemUnderlyingAmount);
 223      }

 225      /**
 226       * @notice Intentionally disabled in CustomYearnStrategy.
 227       * @dev Settlement is routed exclusively through repayPredepositDebt(), which applies
 228       *      the DP-based reserve check, updates accRepaidDebtAmount, crystallizes shortfall
 229       *      when CustomVault is depleted, and releases both committedExternalShares and
 230       *      redeemedButUnsettledShares. The inherited requestClaim() flow from
 231       *      BaseCooldownStrategy bypasses all of that accounting — if a future refactor
 232       *      un-overrode repayPredepositDebt() or emergencyClaim(), calls would silently
 233       *      corrupt invariants (e.g., double-claim, stale reserve checks, missing
 234       *      shortfall crystallization). Reverting here forces any such regression to
 235       *      fail loudly rather than drift.
 236       */
 237      function requestClaim(uint256 /* redeemIndex */)
 238          internal
 239          virtual
 240          override
 241          returns (bool, uint256)
 242      {
 243          revert RequestClaimNotSupported();
 244      }

 246      /**
 247       * @notice Override to exclude committed shares from available balance
 248       * @dev CustomYearnStrategy.requestRedeem() does not actually redeem CustomVault shares —
 249       *      it only records a debt entry. Without this override, premintCooldownVault() would
 250       *      treat the same shares as available for multiple pre-mints. This subtracts
 251       *      committedExternalShares so only uncommitted shares can back new debt.
 252       */
 253      function premintCooldownVault(uint256 sharesNeeded)
 254          internal
 255          virtual
 256          override
 257          returns (uint256 predepositId, uint256 preShares, uint256 lossShares)
 258      {
 259          bool redeemSuccess;
 260          uint256 redeemIndex;
 261          uint256 redeemUsdt;
 262          uint256 _cooldownPeriod;
 263          {
 264              uint256 _needUsdt = cooldownVault.previewMint(sharesNeeded);
 265              uint256 _needSusdt = previewWithdraw(_needUsdt + AMOUNT_TO_SHARE_BUFFER);
 266              uint256 _susdtBalance = externalShareToken.balanceOf(address(this));
 267              // Exclude only committed shares that are STILL in balance. Shares already
 268              // redeemed via withdrawFromCustomVault but not yet settled via
 269              // repayPredepositDebt are naturally absent from _susdtBalance, so subtracting
 270              // the full committedExternalShares would double-count them.
 271              uint256 _effectiveCommitted = committedExternalShares > redeemedButUnsettledShares
 272                  ? committedExternalShares - redeemedButUnsettledShares
 273                  : 0;
 274              uint256 _available = _susdtBalance > _effectiveCommitted
 275                  ? _susdtBalance - _effectiveCommitted
 276                  : 0;
 277              uint256 shares = Math.min(_needSusdt, _available);
 278  
 279              (redeemSuccess, redeemIndex, redeemUsdt, _cooldownPeriod) = requestRedeem(shares);
 280              if (!redeemSuccess) return (0, 0, 0);
 281          }
 282          if (!emergencyExit && redeemIndex == 0) revert InvalidExternalRedeem();
 283  
 284          if (_cooldownPeriod == 0) {
 285              externalUnderlyingToken.forceApprove(address(cooldownVault), redeemUsdt);
 286              preShares = cooldownVault.deposit(redeemUsdt, address(this));
 287              lossShares = sharesNeeded > preShares ? (sharesNeeded - preShares) : 0;
 288              return (0, preShares, lossShares);
 289          }
 290  
 291          (predepositId, preShares) = cooldownVault.predeposit(redeemUsdt);
 292          if (predepositId == 0) return (0, 0, 0);
 293          lossShares = sharesNeeded > preShares ? (sharesNeeded - preShares) : 0;
 294  
 295          externalRedeemIndexes[predepositId] = redeemIndex;
 296  
 297          emit Preminted(predepositId, redeemUsdt, preShares, redeemIndex);
 298      }

 348      /**
 349       * @notice Check if a predeposit debt can be retrieved (DP-based reserve check)
 350       * @dev Uses cumulative debt tracking (same pattern as CooldownVault._claim) to allow
 351       *      out-of-order retrieval while ensuring prior unclaimed debts are reserved for.
 352       *
 353       *      NOTE: This function intentionally does NOT enforce the cooldownPeriod as a timing gate.
 354       *      The cooldown returned by getCooldownPeriod() / requestRedeem() is informational only —
 355       *      it is recorded by CooldownVault for off-chain keeper scheduling, but retrievability
 356       *      is determined solely by whether sufficient USDT liquidity has been prepared.
 357       *      The same applies to the repayment path in repayPredepositDebt().
 358       * @param predepositId The predeposit ID to check
 359       * @return isRetrievable True if full repayment is possible, or if CustomVault is depleted
 360       *         and strategy is insolvent (terminal shortfall — allows bad-debt crystallization)
 361       */
 362      function predepositDebtRetrievable(uint256 predepositId)
 363          external
 364          view
 365          virtual
 366          override
 367          returns (bool isRetrievable)
 368      {
 369          uint256 redeemIndex = externalRedeemIndexes[predepositId];
 370          if (redeemIndex == 0) return false;
 371  
 372          DebtRecord storage record = debtRecords[redeemIndex];
 373          if (record.isClaimed) return false;
 374  
 375          // DP-based reserve check (same pattern as CooldownVault._claim):
 376          // Ensure enough USDT for this debt after reserving for all prior unclaimed debts.
 377          uint256 _accDebtAmount = accDebtAmount[redeemIndex - 1];
 378          uint256 reservedForPriorDebts = _accDebtAmount > accRepaidDebtAmount ? _accDebtAmount - accRepaidDebtAmount : 0;
 379  
 380          uint256 usdtBalance = externalUnderlyingToken.balanceOf(address(this));
 381          uint256 available = usdtBalance > reservedForPriorDebts ? usdtBalance - reservedForPriorDebts : 0;
 382  
 383          if (available >= record.usdtAmount) return true;
 384  
 385          // Allow shortfall settlement when CustomVault is depleted and strategy
 386          // cannot cover the debt — matches the shortfall branch in repayPredepositDebt().
 387          uint256 customVaultValue = customVault.totalAssets();
 388          bool customVaultDepleted =
 389              customVaultValue <= DUST_THRESHOLD || externalShareToken.balanceOf(address(this)) == 0;
 390          uint256 wantAsUsdt = cooldownVault.previewRedeem(want.balanceOf(address(this)));
 391          uint256 totalStrategyHoldings = usdtBalance + wantAsUsdt;
 392  
 393          return customVaultDepleted && totalStrategyHoldings < record.usdtAmount;
 394      }

 404      // ============================================
 405      // REPAY PREDEPOSIT DEBT (OVERRIDE)
 406      // ============================================
 407  
 408      /**
 409       * @notice Repay predeposit debt with already-prepared USDT
 410       * @dev Overrides BaseCooldownStrategy because:
 411       *      1. No external claim needed — USDT is prepared by manager via withdrawFromCustomVault
 412       *      2. Custom shortfall logic: revert unless CustomVault is effectively empty
 413       *      3. DP-based reserve check ensures prior unclaimed debts are reserved for
 414       *
 415       *      Shortfall condition: CustomVault effectively depleted (totalAssets <= dust OR
 416       *      strategy holds no CustomVault shares) AND strategy's total holdings < debt.
 417       */
 418      function repayPredepositDebt(uint256 predepositId)
 419          external
 420          virtual
 421          override
 422          onlyCooldownVault
 423          nonReentrant
 424          returns (uint256 repayAmount)
 425      {
 426          (,, uint256 predepositDebt,,, bool predepositRepaymentFinished) = cooldownVault.predepositRequests(predepositId);
 427          if (predepositRepaymentFinished) {
 428              revert InvalidDebtClaimState();
 429          }
 430  
 431          uint256 redeemIndex = externalRedeemIndexes[predepositId];
 432          DebtRecord storage record = debtRecords[redeemIndex];
 433          if (record.isClaimed) revert ClaimAlreadyProcessed();
 434  
 435          // DP-based reserve check (same pattern as CooldownVault._claim):
 436          // Before paying this debt, ensure enough USDT remains for all prior unclaimed debts.
 437          uint256 _accDebtAmount = accDebtAmount[redeemIndex - 1];
 438          uint256 reservedForPriorDebts = _accDebtAmount > accRepaidDebtAmount ? _accDebtAmount - accRepaidDebtAmount : 0;
 439  
 440          uint256 usdtBalance = externalUnderlyingToken.balanceOf(address(this));
 441          uint256 available = usdtBalance > reservedForPriorDebts ? usdtBalance - reservedForPriorDebts : 0;
 442  
 443          if (available >= predepositDebt) {
 444              // Happy path: full repayment
 445              repayAmount = predepositDebt;
 446          } else {
 447              // Check shortfall condition: CustomVault effectively empty + strategy insolvent
 448              uint256 customVaultValue = customVault.totalAssets();
 449              // Convert want (CooldownVault shares) to USDT equivalent before aggregating
 450              // with raw USDT balance to avoid mixing share and asset units.
 451              uint256 wantAsUsdt = cooldownVault.previewRedeem(want.balanceOf(address(this)));
 452              uint256 totalStrategyHoldings = usdtBalance + wantAsUsdt;
 453  
 454              bool customVaultDepleted =
 455                  customVaultValue <= DUST_THRESHOLD || externalShareToken.balanceOf(address(this)) == 0;
 456              if (customVaultDepleted && totalStrategyHoldings < predepositDebt) {
 457                  // Record shortfall — CustomVault is depleted and strategy cannot cover debt
 458                  repayAmount = available;
 459                  remainingPredepositDebt += predepositDebt - available;
 460              } else {
 461                  // Manager has not yet prepared enough USDT — revert and retry later
 462                  revert InsufficientUSDTForDebtRepayment(predepositDebt, available);
 463              }
 464          }
 465  
 466          record.isClaimed = true;
 467          // Release committed shares now that the debt is settled (or shortfall-crystallized).
 468          //
 469          // The settled debt consumes USDT previously produced by withdrawFromCustomVault.
 470          // Decrementing redeemedButUnsettledShares by record.sharesCommitted (capped at the
 471          // current redeemedButUnsettledShares so it never underflows) releases the
 472          // withdrawn-share allocation paired with this debt. The cap
 473          // `toMark = min(shares, committedExternalShares - redeemedButUnsettledShares)`
 474          // in withdrawFromCustomVault ensures redeemedButUnsettledShares <= committedExternalShares
 475          // always holds, so this direct subtract is safe and semantically correct even when
 476          // settlements occur out of withdraw order (a case where the previous clamp-based
 477          // release failed to decrement redeemedButUnsettledShares and caused effectiveCommitted
 478          // to under-represent the still-in-balance committed shares).
 479          uint256 toRelease = record.sharesCommitted < redeemedButUnsettledShares
 480              ? record.sharesCommitted
 481              : redeemedButUnsettledShares;
 482          redeemedButUnsettledShares -= toRelease;
 483          committedExternalShares -= record.sharesCommitted;
 484          // Increment by full original debt amount (not partial repayAmount) to match CooldownVault pattern.
 485          // Shortfall is already tracked separately in remainingPredepositDebt.
 486          accRepaidDebtAmount += record.usdtAmount;
 487          externalUnderlyingToken.safeTransfer(msg.sender, repayAmount);
 488          emit PredepositDebtRepaid(predepositId, repayAmount);
 489      }

 491      // ============================================
 492      // YEARN STRATEGY FUNCTIONS
 493      // ============================================
 494  
 495      /**
 496       * @notice Estimated total assets, adjusted for outstanding predeposit debt
 497       * @dev Unlike the base implementation, this strategy's requestRedeem() only
 498       *      records an internal debt entry and does not burn CustomVault shares.
 499       *      After premintCooldownVault, the strategy simultaneously holds:
 500       *        (1) externalShareToken (CustomVault shares backing the debt), and
 501       *        (2) want (CooldownVault shares freshly minted against the debt).
 502       *      Naively summing both would double-count the same economic value, so
 503       *      we subtract the USDT amount currently owed to CooldownVault
 504       *      (strategyDebtOutstanding) from the underlying preview before
 505       *      aggregation. remainingPredepositDebt is not subtracted again here
 506       *      because it is already included in strategyDebtOutstanding.
 507       */
 508      function estimatedTotalAssets() public view virtual override returns (uint256) {
 509          uint256 pendingInvested = want.balanceOf(address(this));
 510  
 511          uint256 underlyingToPreview = externalUnderlyingToken.balanceOf(address(this));
 512          underlyingToPreview += previewRedeem(externalShareToken.balanceOf(address(this)));
 513  
 514          // Exclude USDT obligated to CooldownVault — these funds back `pendingInvested`
 515          // (the preminted CooldownVault shares) and must not count as free assets.
 516          // If external position cannot fully cover the debt, propagate the excess into
 517          // pendingInvested so that loss recognition is not suppressed.
 518          uint256 outstandingDebt = cooldownVault.strategyDebtOutstanding(address(this));
 519          if (underlyingToPreview >= outstandingDebt) {
 520              underlyingToPreview -= outstandingDebt;
 521          } else {
 522              uint256 excessDebt = outstandingDebt - underlyingToPreview;
 523              underlyingToPreview = 0;
 524              uint256 excessDebtInWant = cooldownVault.previewDeposit(excessDebt);
 525              pendingInvested = pendingInvested > excessDebtInWant ? pendingInvested - excessDebtInWant : 0;
 526          }
 527  
 528          uint256 previewInWant = cooldownVault.previewDeposit(underlyingToPreview);
 529          return pendingInvested + previewInWant;
 530      }

 532      function prepareReturn(uint256 _debtOutstanding)
 533          internal
 534          virtual
 535          override
 536          returns (uint256 _profit, uint256 _loss, uint256 _debtPayment)
 537      {
 538          uint256 totalAssets = estimatedTotalAssets();
 539          uint256 totalDebt = vault.strategies(address(this)).totalDebt;
 540  
 541          _debtPayment = Math.min(_debtOutstanding, totalAssets);
 542          totalAssets -= _debtPayment;
 543          totalDebt -= _debtPayment;
 544  
 545          if (totalAssets > totalDebt) {
 546              _profit = totalAssets - totalDebt;
 547          }
 548  
 549          (uint256 toReturn,) = liquidatePosition(_profit + _debtPayment);
 550  
 551          // Re-snapshot after liquidation
 552          totalAssets = estimatedTotalAssets();
 553          totalDebt = vault.strategies(address(this)).totalDebt;
 554  
 555          _debtPayment = Math.min(_debtPayment, toReturn);
 556          totalAssets = totalAssets > _debtPayment ? totalAssets - _debtPayment : 0;
 557          totalDebt = totalDebt > _debtPayment ? totalDebt - _debtPayment : 0;
 558  
 559          if (totalAssets > totalDebt) {
 560              _profit = Math.min(toReturn - _debtPayment, totalAssets - totalDebt);
 561              _loss = 0;
 562          } else {
 563              _profit = 0;
 564              _loss = totalDebt - totalAssets;
 565          }
 566      }

 568      function liquidatePosition(uint256 _amountNeeded)
 569          internal
 570          virtual
 571          override
 572          nonReentrant
 573          returns (uint256 _liquidatedAmount, uint256 _loss)
 574      {
 575          _redepositUnderlyingSurplus();
 576  
 577          uint256 pendingInvested = want.balanceOf(address(this));
 578  
 579          // Calculate target reserve to preserve
 580          uint256 reserveRatio = reserveRatioBps;
 581          uint256 targetReserve = reserveRatio > 0 ? Math.mulDiv(estimatedTotalAssets(), reserveRatio, 10_000) : 0;
 582          uint256 actualReserve = Math.min(pendingInvested, targetReserve);
 583  
 584          // Case 1: Small request — fulfill entirely from reserve
 585          if (_amountNeeded <= actualReserve) {
 586              return (_amountNeeded, 0);
 587          }
 588  
 589          // Reserve surplus beyond target (can use without touching targetReserve)
 590          uint256 availableWithoutReserve = pendingInvested > actualReserve ? pendingInvested - actualReserve : 0;
 591  
 592          // Case 2: Can fulfill without touching targetReserve
 593          if (availableWithoutReserve >= _amountNeeded) {
 594              return (_amountNeeded, 0);
 595          }
 596  
 597          // Case 3: Need external withdrawal — premint to preserve reserve
 598          (,, uint256 lossShares) = premintCooldownVault(_amountNeeded - availableWithoutReserve);
 599  
 600          // Use all available want (reserve + newly minted from external)
 601          uint256 available = want.balanceOf(address(this));
 602          if (_amountNeeded > available) {
 603              _liquidatedAmount = available;
 604              _loss = Math.min(_amountNeeded - available, lossShares);
 605          } else {
 606              _liquidatedAmount = _amountNeeded;
 607          }
 608      }

 610      function liquidateAllPositions() internal virtual override returns (uint256 _amountFreed) {
 611          _redepositUnderlyingSurplus();
 612  
 613          // Use uncommitted shares directly instead of estimatedTotalAssets() to avoid
 614          // under-requesting when outstandingDebt > 0 (ETA already deducts debt).
 615          // Only subtract committed shares that are STILL in balance; shares already
 616          // redeemed via withdrawFromCustomVault (redeemedButUnsettledShares) are
 617          // naturally absent from shareBalance and must not be double-counted.
 618          uint256 shareBalance = externalShareToken.balanceOf(address(this));
 619          uint256 _effectiveCommitted = committedExternalShares > redeemedButUnsettledShares
 620              ? committedExternalShares - redeemedButUnsettledShares
 621              : 0;
 622          uint256 uncommitted = shareBalance > _effectiveCommitted ? shareBalance - _effectiveCommitted : 0;
 623          if (uncommitted > 0) {
 624              uint256 uncommittedWant = cooldownVault.previewDeposit(previewRedeem(uncommitted));
 625              premintCooldownVault(uncommittedWant);
 626          }
 627  
 628          uint256 gross = want.balanceOf(address(this));
 629          _amountFreed = remainingPredepositDebt >= gross ? 0 : gross - remainingPredepositDebt;
 630      }

 632      /**
 633       * @notice Deploy idle CooldownVault shares into CustomVault
 634       * @dev InstantRedeem CooldownVault shares → USDT → deposit to CustomVault.
 635       *      Respects reserve ratio and shortfall tolerance.
 636       */
 637      function adjustPosition(uint256 _debtOutstanding) internal virtual override nonReentrant {
 638          if (emergencyExit) return;
 639  
 640          // Block investment if accumulated shortfall exceeds tolerance
 641          if (remainingPredepositDebt > shortfallTolerance) return;
 642  
 643          // Redeposit USDT surplus to CooldownVault (keeps reserve for debt)
 644          _redepositUnderlyingSurplus();
 645  
 646          uint256 pendingInvested = want.balanceOf(address(this));
 647          if (_debtOutstanding >= pendingInvested) return;
 648  
 649          // Calculate investable amount while preserving target reserve
 650          uint256 availableShares = pendingInvested - _debtOutstanding;
 651          uint256 reserveRatio = reserveRatioBps;
 652          if (reserveRatio > 0) {
 653              uint256 targetReserve = Math.mulDiv(estimatedTotalAssets(), reserveRatio, 10_000);
 654              if (availableShares <= targetReserve) return;
 655              availableShares = availableShares - targetReserve;
 656          }
 657  
 658          // InstantRedeem CooldownVault shares → USDT
 659          uint256 toInvestShares;
 660          unchecked {
 661              uint256 _free = cooldownVault.maxInstantRedeem(address(this));
 662              toInvestShares = Math.min(_free, availableShares);
 663          }
 664          if (toInvestShares == 0) return;
 665  
 666          uint256 toInvestAssets = cooldownVault.instantRedeem(toInvestShares);
 667  
 668          // Deposit USDT to CustomVault, return unfilled to CooldownVault
 669          (,, uint256 filledAssets) = requestDeposit(toInvestAssets);
 670          uint256 unfilledAssets = toInvestAssets - filledAssets;
 671  
 672          if (unfilledAssets > 0) {
 673              externalUnderlyingToken.forceApprove(address(cooldownVault), unfilledAssets);
 674              cooldownVault.deposit(unfilledAssets, address(this));
 675          }
 676  
 677          emit AdjustPosition(this.getUtilizationRate(), filledAssets, unfilledAssets, estimatedTotalAssets());
 678      }

 681          // Block migration if there is outstanding predeposit debt to CooldownVault
 682          _requireNoOutstandingDebt();

 684          // Atomically hand off CustomVault execution authority so that share custody
 685          // and deposit/withdraw/redeem permissions stay aligned after migration.
 686          customVault.migrateCustomYearnStrategy(_newStrategy);

 688          // Transfer CustomVault shares
 689          uint256 externalShareBal = externalShareToken.balanceOf(address(this));
 690          if (externalShareBal > 0) {
 691              externalShareToken.safeTransfer(_newStrategy, externalShareBal);
 692          }
 693

 695          uint256 externalUnderlyingBal = externalUnderlyingToken.balanceOf(address(this));
 696          if (externalUnderlyingBal > 0) {
 697              externalUnderlyingToken.safeTransfer(_newStrategy, externalUnderlyingBal);
 698          }
 699      }

 714      // ============================================
