 716      /**
 717       * @notice Withdraw USDT from CustomVault by redeeming shares
 718       * @dev Used by keeper to prepare USDT for predeposit debt repayment.
 719       *      This is the manual step that replaces the automatic claim flow.
 720       *
 721       *      NOTE: This function intentionally has no guard against committedExternalShares.
 722       *      Unlike other strategies where committed shares must not be redeemed externally,
 723       *      CustomYearnStrategy.requestRedeem() only records a debt entry without burning
 724       *      shares. The keeper MUST call this function to convert committed shares into USDT
 725       *      before repayPredepositDebt() can settle the debt. estimatedTotalAssets() remains
 726       *      correct because USDT received substitutes for the burned share value, and
 727       *      outstandingDebt subtraction prevents double-counting.
 728       * @param shares Number of CustomVault shares to redeem
 729       * @return assets Amount of USDT received
 730       */
 731      function withdrawFromCustomVault(uint256 shares) external onlyKeepers nonReentrant returns (uint256 assets) {
 732          assets = customVault.redeem(shares, address(this), address(this));
 733  
 734          // Mark the portion of the withdrawn shares that corresponds to still-unsettled
 735          // committed debt. Any excess is keeper preparation that does not affect debt
 736          // accounting and is intentionally NOT recorded, so the invariant
 737          // redeemedButUnsettledShares <= committedExternalShares always holds.
 738          uint256 unmarkedCommitted = committedExternalShares > redeemedButUnsettledShares
 739              ? committedExternalShares - redeemedButUnsettledShares
 740              : 0;
 741          uint256 toMark = shares < unmarkedCommitted ? shares : unmarkedCommitted;
 742          if (toMark > 0) {
 743              redeemedButUnsettledShares += toMark;
 744          }
 745  
 746          emit WithdrawnFromCustomVault(shares, assets);
 747      }

 753      /**
 754       * @notice Update the informational cooldown period
 755       * @dev This cooldown is NOT enforced on-chain. It serves as a hint to CooldownVault
 756       *      and off-chain keepers for scheduling USDT preparation. Retrievability and
 757       *      repayment are gated by liquidity availability, not elapsed time.
 758       * @param _newCooldownPeriod New cooldown period in seconds
 759       */
 760      function setCooldownPeriod(uint256 _newCooldownPeriod) external onlyGovernance {
 761          if (_newCooldownPeriod == 0) revert InvalidCooldownPeriod();
 762          uint256 oldPeriod = cooldownPeriod;
 763          cooldownPeriod = _newCooldownPeriod;
 764          emit CooldownPeriodUpdated(oldPeriod, _newCooldownPeriod);
 765      }

 767      /// @notice Updates the reserve ratio for want shares reserve
 768      /// @param newRatioBps The new reserve ratio in basis points (0 = disabled, 100 = 1%)
 769      function setReserveRatio(uint256 newRatioBps) external onlyGovernance {
 770          if (newRatioBps > MAX_RESERVE_RATIO_BPS) revert InvalidReserveRatio();
 771          uint256 oldRatioBps = reserveRatioBps;
 772          reserveRatioBps = newRatioBps;
 773          emit ReserveRatioUpdated(oldRatioBps, newRatioBps);
 774      }

 794          revert EmergencyClaimNotSupported();

 418       *  events can be tracked externally by indexing agents.
 419       * @return True if the strategy is actively managing a position.
 420       */
 421      function isActive() public view returns (bool) {
 422          return vault.strategies(address(this)).debtRatio > 0 || estimatedTotalAssets() > 0;
 423      }
 424  
 425      /**
 426       * Perform any Strategy unwinding or other calls necessary to capture the
 427       * "free return" this Strategy has generated since the last time its core
 428       * position(s) were adjusted. Examples include unwrapping extra rewards.
 429       * This call is only used during "normal operation" of a Strategy, and
 430       * should be optimized to minimize losses as much as possible.
 431       *
 432       * This method returns any realized profits and/or realized losses
 433       * incurred, and should return the total amounts of profits/losses/debt
 434       * payments (in `want` tokens) for the Vault's accounting (e.g.
 435       * `want.balanceOf(this) >= _debtPayment + _profit`).
 436       *
 437       * `_debtOutstanding` will be 0 if the Strategy is not past the configured
 438       * debt limit, otherwise its value will be how far past the debt limit
 439       * the Strategy is. The Strategy's debt limit is configured in the Vault.
 440       *
 441       * NOTE: `_debtPayment` should be less than or equal to `_debtOutstanding`.
 442       *       It is okay for it to be less than `_debtOutstanding`, as that
 443       *       should only used as a guide for how much is left to pay back.
 444       *       Payments should be made to minimize loss from slippage, debt,
 445       *       withdrawal fees, etc.
 446       *
 447       * See `vault.debtOutstanding()`.
 448       */
 449      function prepareReturn(uint256 _debtOutstanding)
 450          internal
 451          virtual
 452          returns (uint256 _profit, uint256 _loss, uint256 _debtPayment);
 453  
 454      /**
 455       * Perform any adjustments to the core position(s) of this Strategy given
 456       * what change the Vault made in the "investable capital" available to the
 457       * Strategy. Note that all "free capital" in the Strategy after the report
 458       * was made is available for reinvestment. Also note that this number
 459       * could be 0, and you should handle that scenario accordingly.
 460       *
 461       * See comments regarding `_debtOutstanding` on `prepareReturn()`.
 462       */
 463      function adjustPosition(uint256 _debtOutstanding) internal virtual;
 464  
 465      /**
 466       * Liquidate up to `_amountNeeded` of `want` of this strategy's positions,
 467       * irregardless of slippage. Any excess will be re-invested with `adjustPosition()`.
 468       * This function should return the amount of `want` tokens made available by the
 469       * liquidation. If there is a difference between them, `_loss` indicates whether the
 470       * difference is due to a realized loss, or if there is some other sitution at play
 471       * (e.g. locked funds) where the amount made available is less than what is needed.
 472       *
 473       * NOTE: The invariant `_liquidatedAmount + _loss <= _amountNeeded` should always be maintained
 474       */
 475      function liquidatePosition(uint256 _amountNeeded)
 476          internal
 477          virtual
 478          returns (uint256 _liquidatedAmount, uint256 _loss);
 479  
 480      /**
 481       * Liquidate everything and returns the amount that got freed.
 482       * This function is used during emergency exit instead of `prepareReturn()` to
 483       * liquidate all of the Strategy's positions back to the Vault.
 484       */
 485      function liquidateAllPositions() internal virtual returns (uint256 _amountFreed);
 486  
 487      /**
 488       * @notice
 489       *  Provide a signal to the keeper that `tend()` should be called. The
 490       *  keeper will provide the estimated gas cost that they would pay to call
 491       *  `tend()`, and this function should use that estimate to make a
 492       *  determination if calling it is "worth it" for the keeper. This is not
 493       *  the only consideration into issuing this trigger, for example if the
 494       *  position would be negatively affected if `tend()` is not called
 495       *  shortly, then this can return `true` even if the keeper might be
 496       *  "at a loss" (keepers are always reimbursed by Yearn).
 497       * @dev
 498       *  `callCostInWei` must be priced in terms of `wei` (1e-18 ETH).
 499       *
 500       *  This call and `harvestTrigger()` should never return `true` at the same
 501       *  time.
 502       * @param callCostInWei The keeper's estimated gas cost to call `tend()` (in wei).
 503       * @return `true` if `tend()` should be called, `false` otherwise.
 504       */
 505      function tendTrigger(uint256 callCostInWei) public view virtual returns (bool) {
 506          // We usually don't need tend, but if there are positions that need
 507          // active maintainence, overriding this function is how you would
 508          // signal for that.
 509          // If your implementation uses the cost of the call in want, you can
 510          // use uint256 callCost = ethToWant(callCostInWei);
 511          // It is highly suggested to use the baseFeeOracle here as well.
 512  
 513          return false;
 514      }
 515  
 516      /**
 517       * @notice
 518       *  Adjust the Strategy's position. The purpose of tending isn't to
 519       *  realize gains, but to maximize yield by reinvesting any returns.
 520       *
 521       *  See comments on `adjustPosition()`.
 522       *
 523       *  This may only be called by governance, the strategist, or the keeper.
 524       */
 525      function tend() external onlyKeepers {
 526          // Don't take profits with this call, but adjust for better gains
 527          adjustPosition(vault.debtOutstanding());
 528      }
 529  
 530      /**
 531       * @notice
 532       *  Provide a signal to the keeper that `harvest()` should be called. The
 533       *  keeper will provide the estimated gas cost that they would pay to call
 534       *  `harvest()`, and this function should use that estimate to make a
 535       *  determination if calling it is "worth it" for the keeper. This is not
 536       *  the only consideration into issuing this trigger, for example if the
 537       *  position would be negatively affected if `harvest()` is not called
 538       *  shortly, then this can return `true` even if the keeper might be "at a
 539       *  loss" (keepers are always reimbursed by Yearn).
 540       * @dev
 541       *  `callCostInWei` must be priced in terms of `wei` (1e-18 ETH).
 542       *
 543       *  This call and `tendTrigger` should never return `true` at the
 544       *  same time.
 545       *
 546       *  See `maxReportDelay`, `creditThreshold` to adjust the
 547       *  strategist-controlled parameters that will influence whether this call
 548       *  returns `true` or not. These parameters will be used in conjunction
 549       *  with the parameters reported to the Vault (see `params`) to determine
 550       *  if calling `harvest()` is merited.
 551       *
 552       *  This trigger also checks the network's base fee to avoid harvesting during
 553       *  times of high network congestion.
 554       *
 555       *  Consider use of super.harvestTrigger() in any override to build on top
 556       *  of this logic instead of replacing it. For example, if using `minReportDelay`.
 557       *
 558       *  It is expected that an external system will check `harvestTrigger()`.
 559       *  This could be a script run off a desktop or cloud bot (e.g.
 560       *  https://github.com/iearn-finance/yearn-vaults/blob/main/scripts/keep.py),
 561       *  or via an integration with the Keep3r network (e.g.
 562       *  https://github.com/Macarse/GenericKeep3rV2/blob/master/contracts/keep3r/GenericKeep3rV2.sol).
 563       * @param callCostInWei The keeper's estimated gas cost to call `harvest()` (in wei).
 564       * @return `true` if `harvest()` should be called, `false` otherwise.
 565       */
 566      function harvestTrigger(uint256 callCostInWei) public view virtual returns (bool) {
 567          // Should not trigger if strategy is not active (no assets or no debtRatio)
 568          if (!isActive()) return false;
 569  
 570          // check if the base fee gas price is higher than we allow. if it is, block harvests.
 571          if (!isBaseFeeAcceptable()) return false;
 572  
 573          // trigger if we want to manually harvest, but only if our gas price is acceptable
 574          if (forceHarvestTriggerOnce) return true;
 575  
 576          // Should trigger if hasn't been called in a while
 577          StrategyParams memory params = vault.strategies(address(this));
 578          if ((block.timestamp - params.lastReport) >= maxReportDelay) return true;
 579  
 580          // harvest our credit if it's above our threshold or return false
 581          return (vault.creditAvailable() > creditThreshold);
 582      }
 583  
 584      /**
 585       * @notice
 586       *  Check if the current network base fee is below our external target. If
 587       *  not, then harvestTrigger will return false.
 588       * @return `true` if `harvest()` should be allowed, `false` otherwise.
 589       */
 590      function isBaseFeeAcceptable() public view returns (bool) {
 591          if (baseFeeOracle == address(0)) return true;
 592          else return IBaseFeeOracle(baseFeeOracle).isCurrentBaseFeeAcceptable();
 593      }
 594  
 595      /**
 596       * @notice
 597       *  Harvests the Strategy, recognizing any profits or losses and adjusting
 598       *  the Strategy's position.
 599       *
 600       *  In the rare case the Strategy is in emergency shutdown, this will exit
 601       *  the Strategy's position.
 602       *
 603       *  This may only be called by governance, the strategist, or the keeper.
 604       * @dev
 605       *  When `harvest()` is called, the Strategy reports to the Vault (via
 606       *  `vault.report()`), so in some cases `harvest()` must be called in order
 607       *  to take in profits, to borrow newly available funds from the Vault, or
 608       *  otherwise adjust its position. In other cases `harvest()` must be
 609       *  called to report to the Vault on the Strategy's position, especially if
 610       *  any losses have occurred.
 611       */
 612      function harvest() external onlyKeepers {
 613          uint256 profit = 0;
 614          uint256 loss = 0;
 615          uint256 debtOutstanding = vault.debtOutstanding();
 616          uint256 debtPayment = 0;
 617          if (emergencyExit) {
 618              // Free up as much capital as possible
 619              uint256 amountFreed = liquidateAllPositions();
 620              if (amountFreed < debtOutstanding) {
 621                  loss = debtOutstanding - amountFreed;
 622              } else if (amountFreed > debtOutstanding) {
 623                  profit = amountFreed - debtOutstanding;
 624              }
 625              debtPayment = debtOutstanding - loss;
 626          } else {
 627              // Free up returns for Vault to pull
 628              (profit, loss, debtPayment) = prepareReturn(debtOutstanding);
 629          }
 630  
 631          // we're done harvesting, so reset our trigger if we used it
 632          forceHarvestTriggerOnce = false;
 633          emit ForcedHarvestTrigger(false);
 634  
 635          // Allow Vault to take up to the "harvested" balance of this contract,
 636          // which is the amount it has earned since the last time it reported to
 637          // the Vault.
 638          uint256 totalDebt = vault.strategies(address(this)).totalDebt;
 639          debtOutstanding = vault.report(profit, loss, debtPayment);
 640  
 641          // Check if free returns are left, and re-invest them
 642          adjustPosition(debtOutstanding);
 643  
 644          // call healthCheck contract
 645          if (doHealthCheck && healthCheck != address(0)) {
 646              if (!IHealthCheck(healthCheck).check(profit, loss, debtPayment, debtOutstanding, totalDebt)) {
 647                  revert FailedHealthCheck();
 648              }
 649          } else {
 650              emit SetDoHealthCheck(true);
 651              doHealthCheck = true;
 652          }
 653  
 654          emit Harvested(profit, loss, debtPayment, debtOutstanding);
 655      }
 656  
 657      /**
 658       * @notice
 659       *  Withdraws `_amountNeeded` to `vault`.
 660       *
 661       *  This may only be called by the Vault.
 662       * @param _amountNeeded How much `want` to withdraw.
 663       * @return _loss Any realized losses
 664       */
 665      function withdraw(uint256 _amountNeeded) external returns (uint256 _loss) {
 666          if (msg.sender != address(vault)) revert NotVault();
 667          // Liquidate as much as possible to `want`, up to `_amountNeeded`
 668          uint256 amountFreed;
 669          (amountFreed, _loss) = liquidatePosition(_amountNeeded);
 670          // Send it directly back (NOTE: Using `msg.sender` saves some gas here)
 671          want.safeTransfer(msg.sender, amountFreed);
 672          // NOTE: Reinvest anything leftover on next `tend`/`harvest`
 673      }
 674  
 675      /**
 676       * Do anything necessary to prepare this Strategy for migration, such as
 677       * transferring any reserve or LP tokens, CDPs, or other tokens or stores of
 678       * value.
 679       */
 680      function prepareMigration(address _newStrategy) internal virtual;
 681  
 682      /**
 683       * @notice
 684       *  Transfers all `want` from this Strategy to `_newStrategy`.
 685       *
 686       *  This may only be called by the Vault.
 687       * @dev
 688       * The new Strategy's Vault must be the same as this Strategy's Vault.
 689       *  The migration process should be carefully performed to make sure all
 690       * the assets are migrated to the new address, which should have never
 691       * interacted with the vault before.
 692       * @param _newStrategy The Strategy to migrate to.
 693       */
 694      function migrate(address _newStrategy) external {
 695          require(msg.sender == address(vault));
 696          require(BaseStrategy(_newStrategy).vault() == vault);
 697          prepareMigration(_newStrategy);
 698          want.safeTransfer(_newStrategy, want.balanceOf(address(this)));
 699      }
 700  
 701      /**
 702       * @notice
 703       *  Activates emergency exit. Once activated, the Strategy will exit its
 704       *  position upon the next harvest, depositing all funds into the Vault as
 705       *  quickly as is reasonable given on-chain conditions.
 706       *
 707       *  This may only be called by governance or the strategist.
 708       * @dev
 709       *  See `vault.setEmergencyShutdown()` and `harvest()` for further details.
 710       */
 711      function setEmergencyExit() external onlyEmergencyAuthorized {
 712          emergencyExit = true;
 713          if (vault.strategies(address(this)).debtRatio != 0) {
 714              vault.revokeStrategy();
 715          }
 716  
 717          emit EmergencyExitEnabled();
 718      }
 719  
 720      /**
 721       * Override this to add all tokens/tokenized positions this contract
 722       * manages on a *persistent* basis (e.g. not just for swapping back to
 723       * want ephemerally).
 724       *
 725       * NOTE: Do *not* include `want`, already included in `sweep` below.
 726       *
 727       * Example:
 728       * ```
 729       *    function protectedTokens() internal override view returns (address[] memory) {
 730       *      address[] memory protected = new address[](3);
 731       *      protected[0] = tokenA;
 732       *      protected[1] = tokenB;
 733       *      protected[2] = tokenC;
 734       *      return protected;
 735       *    }
 736       * ```
 737       */
 738      function protectedTokens() internal view virtual returns (address[] memory);
 739  
 740      /**
 741       * @notice
 742       *  Removes tokens from this Strategy that are not the type of tokens
 743       *  managed by this Strategy. This may be used in case of accidentally
 744       *  sending the wrong kind of token to this Strategy.
 745       *
 746       *  Tokens will be sent to `governance()`.
 747       *
 748       *  This will fail if an attempt is made to sweep `want`, or any tokens
 749       *  that are protected by this Strategy.
 750       *
 751       *  This may only be called by governance.
 752       * @dev
 753       *  Implement `protectedTokens()` to specify any additional tokens that
 754       *  should be protected from sweeping in addition to `want`.
 755       * @param _token The token to transfer out of this vault.
 756       */
 757      function sweep(address _token) external onlyGovernance {
 758          if (_token == address(want)) revert SweepTokenIsWant();
 759          if (_token == address(vault)) revert SweepTokenIsVaultShares();
 760  
 761          address[] memory _protectedTokens = protectedTokens();
 762          for (uint256 i; i < _protectedTokens.length; i++) {
 763              if (_token == _protectedTokens[i]) revert TokenProtected();
 764          }
 765  
 766          IERC20(_token).safeTransfer(governance(), IERC20(_token).balanceOf(address(this)));
 767      }
 768  }
 769  
 770  abstract contract BaseStrategyInitializable is BaseStrategy {
 771      bool public isOriginal = true;
 772  
 773      event Cloned(address indexed clone);
 774  
 775      constructor(address _vault) BaseStrategy(_vault) { }
 776  
 777      function initialize(address _vault, address _strategist, address _rewards, address _keeper) external virtual {
 778          _initialize(_vault, _strategist, _rewards, _keeper);
 779      }
 780  
 781      function clone(address _vault) external returns (address) {
 782          return clone(_vault, msg.sender, msg.sender, msg.sender);
 783      }
 784  
 785      function clone(
 786          address _vault,
 787          address _strategist,
 788          address _rewards,
 789          address _keeper
 790      )
 791          public
 792          returns (address newStrategy)
 793      {
 794          if (!isOriginal) revert NotOriginal();
 795          // Copied from https://github.com/optionality/clone-factory/blob/master/contracts/CloneFactory.sol
 796          bytes20 addressBytes = bytes20(address(this));
 797  
 798          assembly {
 799              // EIP-1167 bytecode
 800              let clone_code := mload(0x40)
 801              mstore(clone_code, 0x3d602d80600a3d3981f3363d3d373d3d3d363d73000000000000000000000000)
 802              mstore(add(clone_code, 0x14), addressBytes)
 803              mstore(add(clone_code, 0x28), 0x5af43d82803e903d91602b57fd5bf30000000000000000000000000000000000)
 804              newStrategy := create(0, clone_code, 0x37)
 805          }
 806  
 807          BaseStrategyInitializable(newStrategy).initialize(_vault, _strategist, _rewards, _keeper);
 808  
 809          emit Cloned(newStrategy);
 810      }
 811  }
